title: The 15 s hand-off timer (US-09 AC45a) runs only while a surface that reads the switch flow is mounted
evidence: Cosmetic. useSwitchFlow (widget-src/standalone/switch-flow.ts) starts the 'stayed' timer in each reader's effect, so with no picker, reconnect panel or storage bar mounted a stalled hand-off stays 'navigating' until one mounts and waits its own 15 s. Every surface that would offer a move is a reader, so nothing can be tapped while it waits; at worst a surface mounted late shows its moves locked up to 15 s longer. Since US-09 AC52 the same timer re-reads the stored home, so that re-read waits with it. Fix if wanted: one page-level timer in switch-flow.ts beside the pageshow listener, started on the 'navigating' transition. Found by the cross-PR review of the 13 Nov merges, beside US-09 AC51 and AC52
